title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K as Bessent fuels yen strength around 153 per dollar
description: Bitcoin trended lower with US stocks on Iran escalation while US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent contributed to fears of a yen carry-trade unwind.

title: Bitcoin SOPR metric sees longest profit run of 2026 as new analysis challenges bear market
description: Bitcoin aggregate onchain profit entered its fourth week, but a popular analyst warned that BTC price “downside risk” remained in place.

title: Silvergate ex-CEO blames Biden pressure for bank’s 2023 wind-down
description: Alan Lane said a “coordinated attack” by the Biden administration made Silvergate’s continued operation untenable and prompted its liquidation.

title: Jack Dorsey’s Block seeks US trust bank charter for Bitcoin, stablecoin
description: The proposed Builders Bank would offer federally supervised digital asset custody but would not accept deposits or issue loans.

title: Cybercrime ringleader Malone Lam pleads guilty in $245M crypto theft conspiracy
description: US prosecutors said Lam organized an international network that targeted cryptocurrency holders through social engineering and home break-ins.

title: New York town weighs crypto mining and AI data center ban
description: One of the first towns in the US to ban Bitcoin mining for 18 months is considering another temporary moratorium extending to data centers and other crypto mining operations.

title: Bitcoin faces key support test at $78.3K as US crude oil hits three-month high
description: Bitcoin fell with US stocks on the opening of Tuesday’s Wall Street trading session as analysis warns that BTC price support at $78,300 must hold.

title: Is Bitcoin too volatile to risk your retirement on?
description: Bitcoin believers see it as an almost certain long-term investment, but retirement demands a different approach. How much crypto exposure is too much for your retirement account?

title: Strategy skips Bitcoin buy to repurchase $176M of STRC preferred shares
description: Strategy repurchased $176 million worth of its STRC preferred stock and doubled the size of its digital securities repurchase program to $2 billion, while pausing on new Bitcoin buys.
